raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 delivered some txn_ts values as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768629721000), which the current CAST to TIMESTAMP rejects. Converted in UTC, these fall on 2026-01-17 06:0x, matching the ~06:00 pattern of the string-format rows in other batches, so they can be parsed as epoch-ms while keeping the existing string casts for other rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH s AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM s;"}}
